primitives.asks: May an unprompted offer be sent to this person at all?

branches.label: Identified and permitted
branches.test: the person is known and at least one contact point is valid and permitted for an offer of this kind

branches.label: Anonymous or not permitted
branches.test: the query cannot be attributed to a person we may contact for this purpose

primitives.state: no offer made; the query cannot be attributed to a reachable person
primitives.reEntry: a later query from an identified person qualifies normally

cancelOn.meaning: the requested window is taken or withdrawn

primitives.reads: the the availability question re-read from the system of record before acting on the timeout

branches.label: Booked unprompted
branches.test: the person reserved or held something for the window themselves

branches.label: Window gone
branches.test: the window they asked about was taken or withdrawn before they acted

primitives.reEntry: a later query with no booking behind it starts a new instance

primitives.does: Re-evaluate what is genuinely bookable now rather than reusing what the query returned. Nothing shown at query time was ever held, and an offer of a window that has since gone costs more than sending nothing would

branches.label: A near window is bookable
branches.test: capacity exists close enough to what was asked for that it answers the same need

branches.label: Nothing fits, waitlist exists
branches.test: no window answers the request and the resource supports a waitlist

branches.label: Nothing fits, no waitlist
branches.test: no window answers the request and there is nothing to put the person on

competition.precedence: below process recovery and selection recovery; alongside interest recovery - an availability enquiry that asked for a specific window outranks inferred interest for the same person
